BiblicalUsage: Gideon is a person named 37 times in Scripture, in Judges. The full story lives on the Gideon profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Gideon in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
